# Reusable exact frozen features

A bounded, non-pickle cache now retains the exact 497 detached features,
recorded-action targets, weights and STOP rows from an authenticated corpus.
It requires separately retained whole-file and original-corpus bindings, exact
encoder parameters/architecture/source, original TRAIN worlds and original
reconstruction costs. It creates no fresh observations or clinical evidence.
Future objectives still need their declared comparison and budgets.

All 52 combined cache/value/planner generated controls pass in 3.36 seconds
(3.857 seconds parent), including exact roundtrip, head-fit equality, zero cache
inference, changed-source/model rejection and bounded-array corruption checks.
These controls do not measure a speedup on patient features. The completed
negative run did not save its arrays; a first real cache requires a paid fresh
reconstruction. Raw data and models are not copied or committed. Source pins
and exact control command/log are retained here.
